name: pnp-sp-fx-aces-chartcard-datavisualizationoptions
title: Data Visualization options for ACE cards
shortDescription: This is a baseline solution demonstrating the different data visualization options for the Viva Connections Cards.
longDescription: This is a baseline solution demonstrating the different data visualization options for the Viva Connections Cards. Line chart support was released as part of the SharePoint Framework 1.19 release and additional bar chart, pie chart and donut charts were introduced with the SharePoint Framework 1.20 release. Data visualization cards can be used to surface relevant business metrics directly in the Viva Connections dashboard, which can be easily accessed using desktop, tablet or mobile experiences.
